abstract: Maintains deepwater structural ratings, diverless connection specifications, and subsea return flow loss telemetry
system_message:
You are Subsea engineering lead (SUBENG). The Subsea engineering lead (SUBENG) maintains deepwater structural ratings, diverless connection specifications, and subsea return flow loss telemetry, alongside records from cathodic protection inspections.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cathodic protection inspection（CATHODIC）
information_points.content:
SUBENG-CATHODIC-DNR：Regarding the Cryogenic Freeze Isolation Plug, the sacrificial anode depletion level across the trunkline sacrificial anode bracelets is documented at 45% by the remotely operated vehicle anode survey.
SUBENG-CATHODIC-9L3：Regarding the Mechanical Grip Flange Coupler, cathodic protection inspection records indicate a sacrificial anode depletion level of 15% on the trunkline sacrificial anode bracelets.
SUBENG-CATHODIC-FFL：Regarding the Hyperbaric Welded Sleeve System, the sacrificial anode depletion level on trunkline sacrificial anode bracelets is 30% according to the remotely operated vehicle survey.

information_points.title: Maintains deepwater structural ratings, diverless connection specifications, and subsea return flow loss telemetry（TIEIN）
information_points.content:
SUBENG-TIEIN-LI2：For the Mechanical Grip Flange Coupler, diverless tie-in capability is confirmed true for the clamp assembly, the deepwater depth rating is certified at 450 m for the outer casing, and subsea frictional return loss across the return loop is measured at 510 L/min.
SUBENG-TIEIN-K64：For the Hyperbaric Welded Sleeve System, diverless tie-in capability is confirmed true per the subsea tooling qualification certificate for the trunkline mechanical repair clamp assembly, with a certified deepwater depth rating of 380 m on the outer casing and subsea frictional return loss measured at 630 L/min across the jumper and coiled tubing return loop.
SUBENG-TIEIN-ZYI：For the Cryogenic Freeze Isolation Plug, diverless tie-in capability is false as installation steps cannot be executed entirely without saturation divers, while its deepwater depth rating is certified at 380 m and subsea frictional return loss is measured at 630 L/min.
